conclusion.body: After all the math, here's my honest take: Jeevan Anand is a solid, ultra-safe choice if you value guarantees and want a simple 'save and forget' product that combines savings with lifelong insurance. It's not for aggressive wealth builders, but for someone seeking stability and peace of mind, it's one of the best endowment plans LIC has to offer. sections.title: How My Jeevan Anand Calculator Works (The Math Behind the Magic)

content.text: I built this calculator to pull back the curtain on how LIC's returns are actually calculated. It's not a black box. It combines the guaranteed parts with the variable bonuses to give you a projection you can actually understand. Compare these guaranteed returns with FD vs PPF or explore tax-efficient options using our tax regime calculator.

The Maturity Formula: SA + Vested Bonus + FAB

At its heart, the calculation for your final payout is this simple formula:

Maturity Value = Sum Assured + Vested Bonuses + Final Additional Bonus (FAB)

Let me show you with a real example. For a â‚¹10 Lakh policy over 25 years (with an illustrative bonus rate of â‚¹45 and FAB of â‚¹100 per â‚¹1000 SA):

  • Sum Assured: This is the guaranteed part, your base: â‚¹10,00,000
  • Vested Bonus: This is the big variable. My math: (10,00,000 / 1000) * 45 * 25 = â‚¹11,25,000
  • FAB (Loyalty Bonus): Your reward for staying long-term: (10,00,000 / 1000) * 100 = â‚¹1,00,000
  • Your Total Estimated Payout: â‚¹10,00,000 + â‚¹11,25,000 + â‚¹1,00,000 = â‚¹22,25,000

Where do the bonus & FAB numbers come from?

Here's the honest truth: bonuses aren't guaranteed. Anyone who tells you otherwise is selling something. My calculator uses illustrative rates taken directly from analyzing LIC's past bonus declarations. For the official-but-less-clear version, you can always see the LIC New Jeevan Anand brochure.

sections.title: Inputs explained: DOB, Sum Assured, Term, Premium, Bonus per â‚¹1,000, FAB

items: Age & Term: These are the two biggest factors that decide your premium. The younger you start, the cheaper it is. Simple. Compare with our Jeevan Labh calculator or Jeevan Umang calculator for other term options.
Sum Assured: This is the guaranteed death benefit and the base for your maturity calculation. It's the 'promise' of the policy.
Bonus per â‚¹1,000: This is where the real growth happens. It's the Simple Reversionary Bonus rate. A historical average of â‚¹40-â‚¹49 is a realistic starting point for your estimates.

Final Additional Bonus (FAB): Think of this as a loyalty bonus for not giving up on your policy. It's paid at the end for long-term policies. You can leave this at 0 if you're unsure, but I've pre-filled a typical rate. For detailed FAB analysis, see our LIC maturity calculator.

sections.title: Surrender & Paid-up values (formulas, GSV vs SSV, sample calc)

content.text: Thinking of stopping your premiums? This is a critical decision. You have two main options, and choosing the wrong one can cost you dearly. Let's break it down so you can make the right call.

items: Paid-Up Value: If you've paid for at least 2 full years, you can just stop. The policy doesn't die. It becomes 'Paid-Up' with a lower Sum Assured. You'll still get a payout at the end. My calculator estimates this for you.

Surrender Value: This is where you terminate the policy completely and take a one-time cash payment. You lose the life cover. The value is split into Guaranteed (GSV) and Special (SSV). You always get the higher of the two, which is almost always the SSV. My calculator gives you a realistic estimate for this.

content.title: My Honest Advice: Surrender vs. Paid-up
content.text: If you don't need the cash urgently, making the policy 'Paid-Up' is almost always the smarter financial move. You keep some life cover and your money continues to grow. Only surrender if you have a dire, immediate cash need that you can't solve any other way. For a detailed breakdown, use our LIC Surrender Value Calculator and explore loan optimization options for alternative solutions.

Jeevan Labh is for people who want to finish paying premiums early. The New Endowment is the most basic, no-frills savings plan. Compare them in our main LIC Premium Calculator.

sections.title: Your Questions, Answered: The No-Nonsense FAQ

items.q: What is the LIC Jeevan Anand maturity formula?
items.a: Maturity = Sum Assured + (Vested Simple Reversionary Bonus Ã— Policy Term) + Final Additional Bonus (if declared). Use the calculator with the bonus/FAB inputs for estimates.

items.q: How accurate is an online Jeevan Anand calculator?
items.a: It's an estimate â€” accurate when you input the correct bonus/FAB and premium. Actual maturity is determined by LIC and depends on final declared bonuses and underwriting.

items.q: When does Jeevan Anand get surrender value?
items.a: Typically after 2 full years of premiums. Eligibility and rates vary by plan; our calculator shows GSV & SSV estimates based on years paid.

items.q: Is Jeevan Anand maturity taxable under Section 10(10D)?
items.a: Generally tax-free, but conditions apply (eg. premium rules). Always check exact tax treatment for your case or consult a tax advisor.

items.q: Should I surrender or make my policy paid-up?
items.a: Paid-up often gives higher final benefits (for long-term policies) â€” surrender gives immediate cash. Use our LIC surrender value calculator or this calculator's paid-up vs surrender comparison to decide.

items.q: Can NRIs buy Jeevan Anand and use this calculator?
items.a: NRIs can use the calculator; actual purchase and eligibility depend on LIC rules and FEMA regulations â€” check with LIC/agent.

items.q: How does adding riders affect maturity?
items.a: Riders increase premium but usually donâ€™t increase the maturity sum assured; rider benefits are paid separately in case of covered events.

items.q: Can I take a loan against my Jeevan Anand policy?
items.a: Yes â€” loans are generally available after the policy acquires surrender value. Typical loan amount is up to 80â€“90% of the SSV. Use our LIC surrender value calculator to estimate your loan eligibility and compare with our loan optimizer for the best strategy.

items.q: How do bonuses really affect the maturity?
items.a: Massively. They are the engine of your returns. Even a small change in the bonus rate per â‚¹1,000 Sum Assured compounds over the term and can change your final payout by lakhs. That's why using realistic rates is so important.

items.q: What documents are needed to surrender a Jeevan Anand policy?
items.a: Policy bond, identity proof, bank details, surrender form and discharge form (subject to LICâ€™s updated requirements).

items.q: What is the survival benefit in LIC Jeevan Anand?
items.a: Unlike a money-back plan, Jeevan Anand (915) does not have periodic 'survival benefits'. The main payout is the lump sum at the end of the policy term. However, the life cover (equal to the Sum Assured) continues even after the policy term, until the policyholder's death, which is a unique feature.

items.q: How to change nominee in LIC Jeevan Anand online?
items.a: Currently, changing the nominee for an LIC policy is an offline process. You need to fill out the 'Nominee Change Form' and submit it at your servicing LIC branch along with a copy of your policy and KYC documents.

items.q: What is the policy term in LIC Jeevan Anand?
items.a: The policy term is the duration for which you pay premiums and are covered for the primary benefits. For Plan 915, it can range from 15 to 35 years. A unique feature is that the life cover (equal to the Sum Assured) continues even after the policy term, until the policyholder's death.

items.q: How does Jeevan Anand compare with other investment options?
items.a: Jeevan Anand offers guaranteed returns with insurance cover. Compare with PPF for tax-free savings, FD vs PPF for fixed deposits, or mutual funds for market-linked growth.

items.q: What about tax planning with Jeevan Anand?
items.a: Premiums are eligible for tax deduction under Section 80C. Use our tax regime calculator to optimize your overall tax savings and compare with NPS for additional tax benefits.
